title: India
attribution: World Climate Simulation materials by Climate Interactive, MIT Sloan, and the UMass Lowell Climate Change Initiative. Updated November 2025. Adapted for nested-agent experiments.
goals: Raise living standards and overcome poverty
Secure developed-country support for clean energy and adaptation
Achieve climate benefits without sacrificing economic development
negotiating_constraints: An unfair mitigation burden on India is unacceptable
Clean energy action cannot come at the expense of development
Rich nations must take significant action proportionate to past emissions
opportunities: Electricity access and reduced fossil imports
climate_risks: Climate risks to development and well-being
adaptation_notes: Goals and qualitative constraints paraphrase the briefing. Baseline commitments, numeric ceilings, finance-role restrictions, personalities and scoring are author-created experimental assumptions, NOT official prescribed positions. Source text reflects November 2025 and is not a live policy fact-check.
